title: With nothing ticked Deactivate is disabled and its hover text says why
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Deactivate parts.
  3. Hover over Deactivate on the dark bar.
  4. Click Deactivate.
  5. Click the part A row.
  6. Hover over Deactivate.
  7. Click the part A row again.
  8. Hover over Deactivate.
  9. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on with nothing ticked.

Step 3:

  • The Deactivate button is shown but dimmed (disabled), and hovering it shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".

Step 4:

  • Nothing opens: no "Deactivate parts?" confirmation appears.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 6:

  • With 1 row ticked the button is bright blue (enabled) and no hover text appears.

Step 7:

  • The bar reads 0 selected.

Step 8:

  • The button is disabled again and hovering it shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".

Step 9:

  • Bulk mode ends and part A is still listed on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R8: “The Deactivate button is disabled while no row is ticked. Hovering it then shows "Tick the parts to deactivate".”
  • S2-N1: “With nothing ticked, the Deactivate button is visible but disabled, so the confirmation cannot open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Deactivate hovered with nothing ticked | "Tick the parts to deactivate" | Tooltip on the disabled button”
